scope: fresh native v2 per-account runtime DDL, no v1/prototype database migration; NOT database opening authority or an implemented Android store

Historical R9 fixture/evidence stays unchanged; runtime DDL fixes are separate.
runtimeChanges: explicit BLOB/INTEGER checks for binary identities/digests and exact counters, U32 key/frame limits

stored_bytes equals actual RBMOBJ1 header+packed bytes+per-frame length/tag; RAW original==packed

object-ID reservation registry persisted before encryption; never delete/reuse reservations, one representation claim. Failed/restarted writes need new fresh plan except adoption of exact already-written immutable bytes before claim
object representation immutable; corrupt/ready state cannot regress; FK/refcount/actual-reference and cursor/epoch checks retained

statementFormat: APK-owned literal SQL blocks separated by exact '-- rebrowser:statement' line. Native initializer executes each whole block, not split on ';' inside triggers. Host tests execute each block with sqlite3.execute, not a permissive entire-script shortcut.
foreignKeys: PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON before business transaction; future Android SQLiteOpenHelper must also setForeignKeyConstraintsEnabled(true) in onConfigure, because PRAGMA inside a transaction cannot enable it
notProvenBySql: private object bytes authenticated or codec verified
source/owner authority or safe filesystem erasure
integrationGate: native trusted per-account DB path/epoch binding, exact catalog handles, schema version fail-closed and transaction admission required; no external raw SQL and no automatic unknown-schema clear
tests: replay prior constraint/ref/cursor/rollback semantics plus6 real historical loopholes, reservation/nonce reuse, binary types, size arithmetic, whole trigger statement loading; fresh in-memory synthetic database only
